exams.title: WBPSC West Bengal Civil Services (Exe) Recruitment 2026
exams.postName: WBCS Group A, B, C & D Officers (Executive & Allied)

eligibility.minQualification: Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline from a recognized University in India. Ability to read, write and speak in Bengali (not mandatory for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali).
eligibility.ageLimit: 21 to 36 years as of 01.01.2026. Age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC of West Bengal.

applicationFee.paymentMode: Online Debit/Credit card, Net banking or Offline Challan

selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination (200 marks, MCQ based screening)
Main Examination (6 Compulsory Papers + 2 Optional Papers for Group A & B)
Personality Test / Interview (200 Marks for Group A & B, 150 for Group C, 100 for Group D)
exams.syllabusHighlights: General Studies, History of India with special reference to National Movement, Geography of India with special reference to West Bengal, Indian Polity and Economy, General Science, English Composition.
exams.summary: Public Service Commission, West Bengal has released official notification for WBCS (Exe) etc. Examination 2026 for recruitment to various administrative posts across WB Government departments.
exams.escGuidanceNotes: ESC Kolkata Employment School will conduct free weekly mock tests and mentoring sessions for registered students. Special focus on Bengali language paper and West Bengal history/geography.
exams.queueRemovalReason: Mandatory links have not been verified yet.

exams.title: SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) 2026 Recruitment
exams.postName: Assistant Section Officer, Inspector (GST/IT/Excise), Sub-Inspector (CBI), Auditor

eligibility.minQualification: Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University or equivalent. Final year students can also apply provided they acquire qualification before cut-off date.
eligibility.ageLimit: 18 to 30/32 years (post-wise variation). Relaxations: OBC: 3 yrs, SC/ST: 5 yrs, PwD: 10 yrs.

applicationFee.scStPwd: Nil (Women / SC / ST / PwD / Ex-Servicemen exempted)
applicationFee.paymentMode: BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, RuPay Credit or Debit cards

selectionProcess: Tier-II Computer Based Examination (Paper I: Math, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, Computer + Data Entry Speed Test)
Document Verification & Medical Examination by User Departments
exams.syllabusHighlights: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Comprehension, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge and Typing speed test (minimum 27 wpm).
exams.summary: SSC has published official notification for recruitment of 14,500+ Group B & C Officers in various Ministries, Departments, and Organizations of the Government of India.
exams.escGuidanceNotes: ESC Kolkata Employment School conducts Tier-I and Tier-II computer lab test simulations every Saturday. Students from West Bengal region are advised to choose Kolkata / Siliguri exam centers.
exams.queueRemovalReason: Mandatory links have not been verified yet.

exams.title: IBPS PO / Management Trainee CRP PO/MT XIV 2026

eligibility.minQualification: A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognized by the Govt. Of India. Basic computer operating knowledge required.
eligibility.ageLimit: 20 to 30 years. Upper age relaxation applicable as per banking norms (SC/ST: 5 yrs, OBC: 3 yrs).

selectionProcess: Preliminary Online Exam (English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability - 100 Marks)
Main Online Exam (Objective 200 Marks + Descriptive English 25 Marks)
Common Interview conducted by participating banks and coordinated by IBPS (100 Marks)
exams.syllabusHighlights: Data Analysis & Interpretation, Reasoning & Computer Aptitude, General/Economy/Banking Awareness, English Language (Letter & Essay writing).
exams.summary: IBPS has invited online applications for the recruitment of Probationary Officers across 11 participating public sector commercial banks in India.
exams.escGuidanceNotes: Banking Awareness study materials updated by ESC faculty are available at ESC Kolkata library. Mock interviews will be arranged for students clearing Mains.

exams.title: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) NTPC Graduate Level Recruitment
exams.organization: Ministry of Railways, Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs)
exams.postName: Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor

eligibility.minQualification: University Degree or its equivalent. Medical fitness standard A-2 for Station Master and Goods Train Manager.
eligibility.ageLimit: 18 to 36 years (with 3-year COVID age concession). Standard SC/ST/OBC relaxations apply.

applicationFee.paymentMode: Online via internet banking, debit/credit cards, UPI

selectionProcess: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 common for all posts)
2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2 separate for each 7th CPC Level)
Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) for Station Master posts
Document Verification (DV) followed by Medical Examination
exams.summary: Indian Railways RRB has announced 8,113 graduate vacancies across all zones including Eastern Railway, South Eastern Railway, and Metro Railway Kolkata.
exams.escGuidanceNotes: Published on esckolkata2003.org. ESC Employment School has initiated dedicated batches for RRB CBT Math and Reasoning shortcut techniques.

exams.title: West Bengal Police SI & Lady SI Recruitment 2026
exams.postName: Sub-Inspector / Sub-Inspectress (UB) and Sergeant in Kolkata Police

eligibility.minQualification: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Physical Measurement: Min Height 167 cm for Male (UB), 160 cm for Female (UB). Ability to speak, read and write Bengali.
eligibility.ageLimit: 20 to 30 years as of 01/01/2026. Age relaxable for SC/ST by 5 years, OBC by 3 years.

applicationFee.scStPwd: ₹20/- (Processing Fee only for SC/ST of WB)
applicationFee.paymentMode: Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Net Banking, e-Wallets, UPI

selectionProcess: Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET: 800m run in 3 min for Male, 400m in 2 min for Female)
Combined Competitive Main Examination (3 papers: English, Bengali/Hindi/Urdu/Nepali, General Studies & Arithmetic - 200 marks)
exams.summary: West Bengal Police Recruitment Board has announced 1,131 posts for Sub-Inspector and Sergeants. Great opportunity for graduates looking for uniform service in WB.
exams.escGuidanceNotes: Physical efficiency training drills organized in collaboration with local youth sports clubs in Kolkata for registered ESC candidates.
exams.queueRemovalReason: Mandatory links have not been verified yet.
